extraction.name: NeedleBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive synthetic framework designed to assess retrieval and reasoning performance in bilingual long-context tasks with adaptive context lengths.
extraction.creator: Mo Li, Songyang Zhang, Taolin Zhang, Haodong Duan, Yunxin Liu, Kai Chen
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is constructed by embedding synthetic, abstract, and fictional statements (needles) into background filler content (haystack) sourced from existing datasets.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is synthetic and may not fully capture the complexity of real-world tasks.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLM retrieval and reasoning capabilities in long-context scenarios.

name.evidence: we introduce NeedleBench, a comprehensive synthetic framework designed to assess retrieval and reasoning performance in bilingual long-context tasks

description.evidence: we introduce NeedleBench, a comprehensive synthetic framework designed to assess retrieval and reasoning performance in bilingual long-context tasks with adaptive context lengths (e.g., 32k, 128k, and beyond).

rai:dataCollection.evidence: The needles are synthetic, abstract, and fictional statements or relational facts, deliberately designed to avoid overlap with any real-world knowledge or pretraining data. The haystack for English tasks is built by extending the prompt with passages from the PaulGrahamEssays dataset (Kamradt, 2023), and for Chinese tasks, we use the ChineseDomainModelingEval dataset (Wei et al., 2023b) to ensure linguistic diversity and high-quality filler content.
